test_title: PYST 08: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in Direct to Indirect Speech.

She said, "Who knows the answer?"

options.text: She told who knows the answer.
She asked who knows the answer.
She said who is knowing the answer.
She asked who knew the answer.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indirect Speech:** She asked who knew the answer.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"Who knows the answer?" becomes "who knew the answer"**
